title: Rogers' egg craft resembles Lazar's sport model

tellings.quote: out as I've described with this egg. It would be very much like his sports model.

plain: Greg Rogers, introduced on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels as a NASA doctor, says he once saw an egg-shaped craft in a secret hangar, somewhere around the Nevada test site and Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in the Nevada desert, sometime between 1989 and about 2000. Rogers says the egg, as he describes it, would be very much like the "sport model", a craft described by Bob Lazar, a man who has claimed he worked on flying saucers at a hidden site near Area 51 called S-4. If true, it would mean two separate people saw the same kind of craft.
